name: Allow + suppressed ForAnyValue never-match (empty [] value)
note: IAM-1508 / S2-guard-parity regression, mirrors the audit repro. A full-admin Allow (Action:* / Resource:*) gated by a ForAnyValue operator over a LITERALLY empty array ([]) can never match, so the engine SUPPRESSES the whole grant as a never-match and emits no finding - a silent CLEAN on a full-admin-looking grant. The shared engine must leave a trace (SUPPRESSED_NEVER_MATCH_ALLOW, coverage INCOMPLETE) so the suppressed grant is never a clean pass. A MODELED key (aws:PrincipalOrgID) is used so the pre-existing unsupported-condition path does NOT mask the fix.
